findings.title: [P2] Reconcile the platform router's source bindings with the current handbook
findings.body: PUB-003 remains NOT_READY: this evidence block identifies handbook lines 1475–1516 as the chart/GitOps procedure and declares current-checkout SHA-256 `c0d4232c…`, but the handbook at both the carrier commit and current HEAD hashes to `6a03109c…`. Those lines now describe telemetry; the chart/GitOps section starts at line 1521. Other router blocks repeat the obsolete handbook binding. The anchor resolves, so link/range existence checks cannot establish that the stated evidence matches its source. Reconcile the affected ranges and digests with the actual handbook, or cite an explicit historical revision containing the claimed bytes and explain its applicability.
